theme.shifts.adjustments.basis: Against the store's own shifts of the {days} days before, void and removed-line rates are flagged only when higher than usual; every edit after the close is flagged. A z-score compares a shift with earlier shifts and is not a judgement of a person.

theme.shifts.adjustments.unscored: A z-score shows — when a shift has fewer than {count} earlier shifts of the store, or when the earlier shifts all have the same rate (for instance no removed line at all), so there is nothing to compare with.
